result:
All 14 queries ran and returned plausible answers. I did not cross-check the answers beyond a quick look at the sample rows. A few answers depend on how qlang prints values:

- **U3, U9, U12:** these return maps, and qlang keys maps by keyword. Customer, category and user names therefore print as keywords (`:ann`, `:tools`).
- **U4 and U5:** I converted keyword names back to strings with `keyword`.
- **U2:** it answered `69.93`.
- **U13:** it answered `CACHE-01,DB-01,WEB-01,WEB-02`.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf (/active | eq true) ~(at :address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") ~(at :assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
U7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/2 | trim | count | gt 0) | map ~({:c (/1 | lower) :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/p) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(allOf (/2 | trim | count | gt 0) ~(/3 | trim | parseJson | ne 0)) | map ~({:n /0 :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)
U11: :d (/defaults) | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :v /1}) | filter ~(/v | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled) | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/v | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: sort ~([(/ts | desc)]) | groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(first | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(allOf (count | gt 0) ~(startsWith "#" | eq false)) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | split "," | map ~(trim | lower) | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "fig" "Elderberry" "cherry" "Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count count :longest (w | sort ~([(/ | count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
